# rlm.md — Recursive Language Models

> rlm.md explains Recursive Language Models (RLMs): an inference technique that lets LLMs process arbitrarily long inputs by treating the prompt as an external environment and recursively calling themselves over snippets. Covers the original research, benchmarks, implementations, and practical applications.

- [Applications -- Where Recursive Language Models Change Things | rlm.md](https://rlm.md/applications.html)

- [rlm.md -- Recursive Language Models](https://rlm.md/)

- [Techniques -- RLM Implementation Details | rlm.md](https://rlm.md/techniques.html)
